rival_reading: The call may have concerned routine field work; a missed handoff alone does not show that officials knew of a wider emergency.
gloss: A field call is deferred while the road channel lacks coverage.
title: Call awaiting initials
body: A caller tried twice before her shift ended at seven. The road channel went uncovered at six; the callback stayed open until a supervisor could initial the box.

rival_reading: The items may have been held as an ordinary precaution during containment; an unclaimed supply set does not establish that the program caused an exposure.
gloss: Agricultural supplies remain grouped with a filter and go uncollected overnight.
title: Filter condition before release
body: The field worker missed the last bus home while the sprayer and fertilizer stayed on hold until the filter's condition was entered. The release box remained blank until morning.
